lines.text: One guard. Fifteen dark rooms. He cannot watch them all.
Inside, an intruder moves unseen. Seen only when his torch flashes.
So the guard checks each room in turn. One at a time.
He watches room four. The torch fires in room ten. Gone before he looks there.
Room three while he watches eight. Twelve while he watches five. Always too late.
Pull back. The building is a spectrum. The rooms are frequency bands.
Intruder: emitter. Torch: transmission. Guard: receiver.
The signal existed. The receiver looked elsewhere.
